axes.model_access: Models are routed on Microsoft's side with a limited user-facing choice: the official narrative says Copilot uses OpenAI-family models (GPT line) plus Microsoft's own MAI line; the current tiering is not verified item by item. "Whether a selector exists and what it offers" is per the signed-in UI.
axes.runtime: Web (copilot.microsoft.com) + Windows-embedded + iOS/Android apps + Edge-embedded; generation is processed on Microsoft's cloud. It is an adjacent but different product surface from Microsoft 365 Copilot (office-suite embedded) — this dossier covers the consumer Copilot.
axes.local_files: Chat history is stored on the Microsoft account side; there are account-linked surfaces with Bing search history and Edge data (governed by the Microsoft privacy dashboard), details not verified item by item.
axes.background: Chats return instantly; the product includes proactive capability lines like "Copilot Vision/Actions" (official narrative); no official statement verified for an async task queue.
axes.tools: Built-in capability lines incl. web retrieval (Bing-based), image generation (Designer/DALL·E line) and image understanding; integration with Microsoft 365 apps belongs to another product surface. MCP support not verified item by item.
axes.context: Chat history syncs when signed in; the cross-session memory mechanism is not verified item by item (there is an official "Copilot Memory"-type narrative; implementation details unverified).
axes.permissions: Microsoft account system (enterprise/personal account lines); the training-use switch is in the Microsoft privacy dashboard (account privacy settings); the exact path and default state not verified item by item.
axes.fit: Suits: Windows/Edge/Bing ecosystem users, free web-connected Q&A, enterprises already in the Microsoft ecosystem. Does not suit: model self-selection, leaving the Microsoft account, or mainland direct-connection scenarios (see the cn block).
